fields.display_title: Our goal is to develop a framework for architecture search in deep learning around the model search space specification language introduced. Our goal is not to propose MCTS as an algorithm for general purpose hyperparameter optimization; rather we propose random, MCTS, and SMBO as simple baseline algorithms for model search that are well-suited to the structures arising from the search spaces induced by our model search space specification language.
